A Heartfelt Little Letter 💌

Okay, jokes aside. This part comes straight from the heart.

Dear Upasana, 🌷

Happy Birthday to a truly beautiful soul! 💗

I hope you know how special you are, not just today but every single day. You have this lovely way of making moments brighter, conversations funnier and memories worth keeping forever.

I hope this new chapter brings you the kind of happiness that stays, friendships that feel like home, adventures that become your favourite stories, and countless reasons to smile.

May you always find flowers wherever you go, chocolate whenever you crave it, beautiful places to explore, and a thousand moments worth capturing through your camera. 📸🌸

Keep being your funny, lovely, slightly dramatic, chocolate-loving self. Never stop dreaming big, laughing loudly or being the wonderful person you are.

And whenever life gets difficult, remember that you deserve the same kindness, love and happiness that you give to everyone around you.

Here's to more silly conversations, unforgettable outings, embarrassing pictures, endless laughter and memories we'll talk about for years. 🥹

You deserve all the beautiful things this world has to offer. Today and always. 💐

With lots of love, your girlie ♡
💗Stay happy, today and always.
🌸May your dreams bloom like flowers.
🍫May your chocolate supply never run out.
📸More adventures, photos and memories!

Never forget how wonderful you are. Keep smiling, keep shining, keep being YOU.

Here's to YOUR beautiful year! ♡
